title: Fe-doping-driven enhancement of electronic conductivity and electrocatalytic performance in Gd2O3 nanoparticles for ultrasensitive electrochemical detection of chloramphenicol in pharmaceutical and milk samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8517-8532
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09035K, Paper
Open Access

Tuan-Anh Nguyen, Nguyen Huu An Nguyen, Ngo Xuan Dinh, Le Thi Thanh Tam, Nguyen Xuan Quang, Le Trong Lu, Manh-Huong Phan, Anh-Tuan Le
Fe doping induces a synergistic enhancement of electronic conductivity and electrocatalytic activity in Gd2O3 nanoparticles, enabling highly sensitive electrochemical detection of chloramphenicol in real pharmaceutical and milk samples.
